description: Basic narrative templates for ant colony scenarios

winter_survival.title: The Coming Winter
winter_survival.setup: Winter approaches and your young colony must prepare. Food becomes scarce, predators grow desperate, and every decision matters for survival.
winter_survival.goal: Survive 10 turns and maintain at least 10 ants

predator_threat.title: The Bird's Shadow
predator_threat.setup: A large bird has been circling your territory. Your scouts report increased predator activity. The colony must decide between hiding and bold action.
predator_threat.goal: Survive the threat and grow to 15 ants

forage: Your workers venture out in formation, antennae twitching as they search for food.
The foraging party moves with purpose, following scent trails to promising areas.
Workers spread out across the territory, carefully avoiding known danger zones.
explore: Scout ants dart ahead, their keen eyes scanning for new opportunities and threats.
The exploration team moves cautiously into unknown territory, leaving scent markers.
Brave scouts climb high and search far, expanding your colony's knowledge.
defend: Soldier ants take position at key points around the nest, mandibles ready.
The colony forms defensive lines, with workers ready to retreat to safety.
Alert guards patrol the perimeter while others reinforce nest entrances.
rest: The colony settles into a quiet rhythm, conserving energy and tending to the nest.
Ants groom each other and share food, strengthening social bonds.
A period of calm allows the colony to recover from recent hardships.

predator_encounter: A sparrow swoops down with deadly precision!
The shadow of a lizard falls across your foraging party!
A spider emerges from hiding, fangs glistening!
food_discovery: Your scouts have found a dropped crumb - a feast for the colony!
A fallen berry provides sweet sustenance for many ants!
Dead insects discovered - protein for the growing colony!
winter_arrives: Frost touches the ground. The easy days of foraging are ending.
Cold winds blow through the territory. Winter has begun.
The temperature drops sharply. Survival becomes the priority.

high_morale: The colony buzzes with activity and purpose!
Your ants work with exceptional coordination!
Spirits are high - the colony feels unstoppable!
low_morale: Your ants move sluggishly, discouraged by recent setbacks.
There's tension in the nest - some ants question the leadership.
The colony struggles with doubt and fear.
low_food: Stomachs growl as food stores dwindle dangerously low.
The sharp pangs of hunger affect every ant's performance.
Empty storage chambers echo with the colony's desperation.
large_population: The nest teems with busy ants - a thriving community!
Your colony has grown into a formidable force!
The tunnels echo with the sound of many busy feet.

changes: Initial narrative templates with scenarios and flavor text
